releaseNotes: IMPORTANT: signing key changed - uninstall the old app before installing this one
Sign in to Google after installing to restore your data from the spreadsheet
Credit categories can now be added, renamed and deleted
Link a category across Debit and Credit (e.g. Home) to net its two sides in Reports
Google Sheets sync now works both ways and restores a device on sign-in
Transaction descriptions are now included in the spreadsheet
Fixed the in-app updater, which could never reach version.json
Budgets no longer offer credit-only categories
